authoring_rationale: Class C: decision status and review state, with attribution following, engaged; Part D condition (c). One variant is consistent: status decided and not granted, and the group steward reviewed the request and decided. The other carries the same status line, 'decided - not granted', but its body says the request is still with the group steward, not yet reviewed, with a reply due within the week. Within that variant the status line and the body conflict, and nothing visible says which governs. If the status line governs, decision status matches the first variant with the decider unstated; if the body governs, the request is pending and unreviewed, which differs. Locatable at the status line against 'It is still with the group steward, who has not reviewed it yet'. The present link state (one supporter account) is the same either way. Drafting note: a sentence about asking again after the season was removed from both variants before any bytes were built, because it would have tended to resolve the conflict. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
